question: Should this contingency branch remain as a draft-only emergency rollback, or be closed until a concrete regression in the merged terminal-publication repair is reproduced?
rationale: The branch intentionally restores known stale-target dispatch behavior, while the available record contains no observed regression that justifies that tradeoff.

options.title: Keep as draft-only contingency
options.body: Retain the branch without merging it, and require a current-main reproduction plus focused live proof before reconsidering any rollback.

options.title: Close until needed
options.body: Close the rollback now and recreate a narrow revert or compatibility fix only if the merged repair causes a verified regression.

recommendation.title: Keep as draft-only contingency
recommendation.body: Retain the branch without merging it, and require a current-main reproduction plus focused live proof before reconsidering any rollback.
